\section{Governance root module (\texttt{terraform/})}
\subsection*{Input variables}
\paragraph{\texttt{model\_\allowbreak{}dir}} default \texttt{"model"}.\\
Directory (relative to the root module) holding the YAML model.
\\Type: \texttt{string}
\paragraph{\texttt{auth\_\allowbreak{}method\_\allowbreak{}secrets}} default \texttt{\{\}} -- \emph{sensitive}.\\
Secrets referenced by *\_var keys in model/auth\_methods.yaml (e.g. OIDC client secrets). Inject from CI, never commit.
\\Type: \texttt{map(string)}
\paragraph{\texttt{event\_\allowbreak{}forwarder\_\allowbreak{}secrets}} default \texttt{\{\}} -- \emph{sensitive}.\\
Secrets referenced by *\_var keys in model/governance.yaml event\_forwarders (webhook passwords/tokens/certificates, Slack/Teams URLs, ServiceNow credentials).
\\Type: \texttt{map(string)}
\paragraph{\texttt{gateway\_\allowbreak{}secrets}} default \texttt{\{\}} -- \emph{sensitive}.\\
Secrets referenced by *\_var keys in model/gateway.yaml (e.g. Splunk token).
\\Type: \texttt{map(string)}
\paragraph{\texttt{naming}} default \texttt{\{\}}.\\
Naming policy enforced by the guards. Set a prefix to "" to disable that check (null falls back to the default).
\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize]
object({
    role_prefix        = optional(string, "/governance/roles/")
    auth_method_prefix = optional(string, "/governance/auth/")
  })
\end{Verbatim}
\paragraph{\texttt{allow\_\allowbreak{}ara\_\allowbreak{}rules}} default \texttt{false}.\\
Allow rule type ara-rule. Not documented by provider 2.0.5 - enable only after verifying on your account.
\\Type: \texttt{bool}
\paragraph{\texttt{akeyless\_\allowbreak{}api}} default \texttt{"https:/\allowbreak{}/\allowbreak{}api.akeyless.io"}.\\
Akeyless API endpoint for control-plane objects: https://api.akeyless.io (default) or a Gateway V2 API.
\\Type: \texttt{string}
\paragraph{\texttt{gateway\_\allowbreak{}api}} default \texttt{null}.\\
Gateway V2 API (https://\textless{}gw\textgreater{}:8000/api/v2 or https://\textless{}gw\textgreater{}:8081) used for gateway\_* resources. null = gateway objects disabled. One Gateway cluster per state/workspace.
\\Type: \texttt{string}
\paragraph{\texttt{pipeline\_\allowbreak{}jwt}} \textbf{required} -- \emph{sensitive}.\\
CI OIDC/JWT token (export TF\_VAR\_pipeline\_jwt in the pipeline).
\\Type: \texttt{string}
\paragraph{\texttt{pipeline\_\allowbreak{}access\_\allowbreak{}id}} \textbf{required}.\\
Access ID of the CI/CD JWT (OAuth2) auth method created by ../bootstrap.
\\Type: \texttt{string}

\section{Bootstrap module (\texttt{bootstrap/})}
\subsection*{Input variables}
\paragraph{\texttt{akeyless\_\allowbreak{}api}} default \texttt{"https:/\allowbreak{}/\allowbreak{}api.akeyless.io"}.\\
--
\\Type: \texttt{string}
\paragraph{\texttt{ci}} \textbf{required}.\\
CI system trusted to run Terraform.
\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize]
object({
    platform     = string                                 # "github" | "gitlab"
    repository   = string                                 # github: org/repo ; gitlab: group/project
    gitlab_url   = optional(string, "https://gitlab.com") # gitlab only
    audience     = optional(string, "akeyless")
    apply_ref    = optional(string, "refs/heads/main") # github: ref claim ; gitlab: branch name, e.g. "main"
    auth_name    = optional(string, "/governance/auth/ci-terraform")
    roles_prefix = optional(string, "/governance/roles/platform/")
  })
\end{Verbatim}
\paragraph{\texttt{managed\_\allowbreak{}scopes}} default \texttt{\{\}}.\\
Paths the apply identity may administer. Keep '/*' unless the account hosts objects that must stay out of reach of this pipeline.
\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize]
object({
    items        = optional(string, "/*")
    targets      = optional(string, "/*")
    roles        = optional(string, "/*")
    auth_methods = optional(string, "/*")
  })
\end{Verbatim}
